title: Standard Shader Ball
author: Chris Rydalch
description: A material evaluation model designed to exercise reflective and transmissive properties. Converted from the two object GLBs distributed with OpenPBR-viewer; original Standard Shader Ball USD asset by Chris Rydalch.
additionalCredits: Specification and validation: André Mazzone. Original scene inspiration and consultation: Thomas Anagnostou.
changes: Repacked as a single GLB; textures limited to 1024px; geometry compressed/quantized with gltf-transform Meshopt without simplification; PNG textures compressed with lossless WebP; default camera embedded; preview rendered with MuTracer and denoised with OIDN standard. Merged the neutral and OpenPBR object GLBs distributed with OpenPBR-viewer and assigned a clear transmissive glass material to the outer shell.
